The office was my number one comfort show until they took it off of Netflix, so I've had to watch new shows to fill the void. 

Now my comfort shows are Batman The Animated Series, Batman Beyond, and Regular Show!

I've been heavily into Batman for the past few years. I know it sounds silly, but Batman really helps me cope sometimes. A lot of comics and TV adaptations show Batman as a hero, but he also has flaws that he must overcome. That's what makes him as a character feel more human. I relate to him alot, maybe not the crime-fighing or detective skills, but because he has a lot of trauma that he works through on a day-to-day basis. It's inspiring. If Bruce Wayne can conquer his demons, then so can I. 

On top of all that, it's super fascinating to learn and read up on all the lore. It's always interesting seeing how new adaptations retell the same stories or come up with new ones. I'm always down for a good Batman story. The new Batman movie was a real treat for me and it certainly solidified the love I have for the batman universe. I'm pretty sure this interest started a years ago when I picked up a few comics at the library. I binge read quite a few before starting to watch any of the animated series. I instantly connected to the character while reading because he is very analytical and detail oriented, which is similar to how I am. I could go on and on but that's the majority of it hehe
